_meta.description: REST 409 vehicle_unavailable / subCode time_conflict (rest-api.md §7.8, MYR-383). Emitted when a reservation create or accept lands strictly inside the per-vehicle conflict window of a ride the car is already committed to. The refusal names the conflicting instant, which is the same disclosure §7.22's read surface makes. Consumers MUST NOT auto-retry the same mutation — the identical POST refuses again.

error.message: vehicle already has a ride around 2026-08-01T19:00:00Z
